reason: Re-opened packet.js gita 10 --verse 10.20 (and 10.19, 10.21 for context): Rāmānuja's commentary on 10.20 in Govindacharya (1898) reads verbatim 'In the hearts of all beings, who constitute My body, I am seated as their Atma (Soul)—To be the Atma is indeed to be in every manner the Support, the Ruler and the Master.' The comment stands at 10.20 (not grouped with a later verse), so the locator holds.
